written.headline: SpaceX plans $24B gas power plant and super-compute facility in Starbase, TX
written.summary: SpaceX plans to construct, own, and operate a gas-fired power plant and super-compute facility in Starbase, Texas, with initial phases carrying an estimated investment of approximately $24 billion. The proposal includes using a super-chilled and purified form of natural gas to fuel rocket launches.

written.headline: Fireworks reports cyberattack exposing customer datasets and model weights
written.summary: AI infrastructure provider Fireworks disclosed that hackers accessed some customers' datasets, incomplete model weights, and billing information over the past month. Two customers told Forbes they had moved their business off Fireworks' systems following the incident.

written.headline: Jensen Huang pulls out of ElevenLabs Summit amid Nvidia controversy
written.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang withdrew from the ElevenLabs Summit and other speaking engagements following an admission of an extramarital affair and an investigation into his relationship with a possible Chinese spy. Nvidia is an investor in ElevenLabs.

written.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 models
written.summary: Anthropic introduced Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, offering 30% faster output generation and improvements in coding, reasoning, and vision. Fable 5.2 is priced at $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens, arriving ahead of the company's anticipated initial public offering.

written.headline: Nvidia board investigates CEO Jensen Huang over affair with alleged spy
written.summary: Nvidia shares fell over 4% after CEO Jensen Huang acknowledged an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, prompting an independent board investigation. The controversy has put the chipmaker's leadership and opaque succession planning under intense scrutiny.

written.headline: OpenAI introduces Control Room to track and stop AI workloads
written.summary: OpenAI introduced Control Room to track model workloads across its research infrastructure. The tool can rapidly stop workloads when safety or security concerns arise.

written.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 with 1M context window
written.summary: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5.2, a proprietary model featuring a 1-million-token context window and text and image input support. The model achieved a score of 65 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index.
